items.title: CoreWeave to Power Wayve's AI Driver Training in Multi-Year Agreement
items.summary: LIVINGSTON, N.J., November 09, 2026--CoreWeave, Inc. (Nasdaq: CRWV), The Essential Cloud for AI®, today announced a multi-year agreement with Wayve, the global leader in embodied intelligence building the AI Driver for autonomous vehicles. Wayve will train its foundation models on CoreWeave Cloud with NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs, expanding its AI infrastructure for training, evaluation, and simulation. Wayve began using Weights & Biases and has now scaled into leveraging CoreWeave Cloud.
